implementation: Admit wallet Uni-STARK proof lengths against the fixed cubic/binary profile before configuration construction or upstream verification. Reject empty or non-power-of-two Merkle caps even when derived deserialization bypasses the constructor. Bound commitments, trace/quotient openings, hiding rounds, FRI layers/queries, authentication salts/paths and the final polynomial.

Count every owned proof Vec backing once, including spare capacities and public values, with checked arithmetic and a 64 MiB ceiling. The gate allocates no memory and its traversal is bounded by the preceding shape envelope.
Construct the statement plus profile/chain limbs in a fixed 376-byte public-value array. Preserve public-field order; perform HTLC/issuance policy checks before constructing inputs.

Reuse the existing bounded native diagnostic writer with wallet-specific labels. Error output is at most 1,024 bytes and final owned diagnostic storage is at most 1,048 requested bytes on this toolchain.

Keep all upstream numerical verifier calls, original AIR implementations, proving functions, formats, parameters and registry identities unchanged. Check four fresh CPU proof types with independent upstream calls and reject altered chain, public values and openings.

limitations: This is an input-envelope/capacity gate, not cryptographic acceptance. Underfilled or otherwise invalid proofs that fit it must still pass the unchanged upstream verifier.

Caller-owned proof allocations already exist when the gate runs; it cannot retroactively reserve them. The execution path retains the separately qualified bounded decoder. Direct callers remain responsible for safe construction/decoding.

Wallet verifier symbolic degree inference, periodic-column construction/evaluation, numeric AIR/PCS/FRI workspaces, configuration construction and runtime lifetimes still need source-derived bounds and composition. The registered BatchProof verifier reservation is not evidence for these paths.

The new 64 MiB input-backing ceiling is not an additional physical reservation or a complete verifier/RSS bound. Existing physical caps, shared/job partition and ordinary incomplete-profile rejection remain unchanged.

Four fresh CPU wallet proofs are unit-test conformance evidence; public proof bytes were not exported from those tests. Four full-size desktop RTX 5080 proofs remain inherited from 9.106. No fresh GPU proof or throughput benchmark was run.

Full worker/coordinator lifetime composition, broader workloads/live caches, nonempty-child full-size merges, paired throughput, 24 hours AND 150 completed roots, multiple GPUs and AMD/Metal remain open. No production activation or throughput gain is claimed.
